records.statement: Seldon shall not deploy managed settings, either an `availableModels` allowlist or denial of superseded models, for model selection, because an `availableModels` allowlist would also bind the operator's interactive sessions and denying superseded models would also disable classifier fallback targets; model order is enforced where calls are made by AD-035-R3 to R6 and proven by the receipt, and the decision is to be revisited if a call site is found that R3 cannot reach.

The prior-art gate shall refuse at two points: when `seldon verify` (pre-commit) sees a commit that adds a design note under `docs/design/` whose prior-art section is missing, has an empty subsection, or fails AD-036-R2, it shall refuse the commit and write the verdict to the governed ledger beside the note's hash; when `seldon cc register` is given a task whose governing note has no passing verdict, it shall refuse the registration; design notes on main at the merge commit of AD-036 are baseline, listed and grandfathered rather than re-litigated; and each refusal shall quote the missing part and name AD-036.
